limits: Shared Linux host, not dedicated hardware. Cold = reopen and empty disposable historical cache; reopen/recovery is excluded from timer and OS/page caches are uncontrolled. Query timer includes as_of capture. VmHWM is cumulative process peak including seed, recovery, indexes, reference values and results; no per-query allocations measured. Current baseline/new engines stay idle between alternating requests; IPC and checksums are outside query timers. No power-loss claim.
timing_units: measured wall-clock microseconds, kept separate from dimensionless estimated work

concurrent.scheduling: one start barrier, scheduler-controlled overlap; controlled publication-boundary tests are separate

historical.memory_scope: cumulative process VmHWM including seed, recovery, cache, reference values and returned rows; not per-query allocation
